about.title: About
about.what: Aurora Studio is a git-native knowledge framework for analysts. A knowledge base of markdown cards with trust statuses, Confluence and Jira mirrors, production of artifacts from verified knowledge, tracing requirements down to acceptance. The engine has no external dependencies: the Python standard library only.
about.skills: Three skills ship with it: aurora-vault — working with the knowledge base, aurora-dev — developing the engine itself, aurora-grill — taking an idea apart along a decision tree: rounds of questions with recommendations until no silent assumptions are left. The last one is run by the planner before an artifact is produced, and it is available to the assistant in chat as well. Installed by the kit:skills command into the agent's shared folder.
about.author: author
about.update_kit: Updating the kit from the repository
about.update_why: The panel can pull a new version of the framework itself. Fast-forward only: merging with someone else's changes by a button in a browser is not something to do blind. After an update the panel has to be restarted: the server is still running the old code.
about.pull_ask:
Update the kit from the repository?

After the update the panel has to be restarted so the server picks up the new code.
